Claude Code 2.1.311, interactive sessions in screen with a clean env, throwaway hooks in a scratch folder (claude -p never offers ExitPlanMode, so headless cannot test it). ExitPlanMode tool_input carries plan (markdown) and planFilePath (~/.claude/plans/<slug>.md); a PermissionRequest fires after PreToolUse, with permission_mode plan and no permission_suggestions. PermissionRequest allow with no updatedInput is ignored (the plan dialog stays), with or without setMode; PreToolUse permissionDecision allow is ignored too. PermissionRequest allow with updatedInput set to the tool_input leaves plan mode: mode becomes default and the next Write raises a PermissionRequest (edits still ask). Adding updatedPermissions [{type: setMode, mode: acceptEdits, destination: session}] makes the mode acceptEdits: Write and Edit ran with no request. PermissionRequest deny with a message keeps plan mode and Claude reads the message as feedback. The relay can approve a plan safely: allow must carry updatedInput.

G-1 evidence 2026-10-29: signal-relay@signal-plugin-cc 0.3.0 installed from the public marketplace at local scope in a scratch project; an interactive session (manual mode) asked a Bash permission and an AskUserQuestion while the Mac was idle; the owner answered from the phone, a thumbs-up and a poll answer; relay.log: permission tag 9531 answered after 54.3 s, question tag d6d6 answered after 10.2 s; the file was created and the session got Red. Repo PUBLIC, main protected by ruleset 26150186 (owner ran both), Tests on main green at 3771618. Spinner observation still to come from the owner. Learned: a prompt typed into the session counts as the owner at the Mac and turns away off, so live tests must rely on idle time.
